}}'''Suladric''' was [[clan chief]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].

== History ==
Suladric fell for [[Sevanna]] when she was sixteen. Sevanna laid the bridal wreath at his feet because he was clan chief and she had ambition.{{ref|{{twotc|Suladric}}}}{{ref|{{twotc|Sevanna}}}}

When he died, he was survived by his widow, Sevanna.{{ref/book|4|23}}
